content:
alex: Draft for the product launch blog is up: https://drive.redwood.com/launch/draft-v6. Quick asks: tighten hero, confirm benchmark wording, paste HubSpot wiring, and FAQ entry for demo-seat allocation. Can people review today?

marta: On it. Editorial first pass: remove hyperbole in opener and show a 3-step demo signup microflow right under the CTA.

sam: Benchmark proposal: "In mixed chat + long-context tests (avg conv ~700 tokens), Redwood lowered per-token compute by approximately 2525-30% vs baseline (see run_2026_03_30_v2, s3://redwood-evals/2026/03/30/run_v2/metrics.csv)." Keeping as a range for legal.

alex: Works for me. Kasia/legal to confirm.

kasia: Please attach the CSV link (Sam pasted it). Legal prefers the range and a one-line methodology: hardware parity and per-token normalization. Also fill the claim sign-off checklist in the doc.

jenni: Webinar details to include in the post: Tue 2026-04-06 09:00 PT, capacity 250, ops reserved 50 demo seats. Demand gen asks: enterprise-tagged leads get priority for a 48-hour window; allocation: 2 seats for enterprise during window, 1 afterward.

oliver: Ops can implement that. Paste HubSpot mapping so I can pre-provision webhooks. Also will run a dry test tomorrow morning.

sam: HubSpot snippet to paste in Integration appendix:
```hubspot_form_id: hs_999210
properties:
  email: contact.email
  company: contact.company
  lead_tier: single_select (enterprise,startup,other)
  campaign: product_launch_apr2026
webhook: https://hooks.redwood.com/hs/launch-2026```

ops-bot: automated-check: webhook reachable; test event accepted (200 OK).

privacy-bot: auto-scan: collected fields are email and company only. Reminder: include retention period and EU routing note if applicable.

kasia: Draft CTA microcopy: "Register to see the launch and request a demo." Legal also requests: "EU leads are routed to our EU HubSpot instance; contact data retained up to 18 months (Privacy confirmation pending)."

marta: Editorial tweak: under the hero show microflow: 1) Register 2) Confirm by email 3) Book demo (optional). Move full allocation rules to FAQ.

alex: Timeline: editorial + ops sign-off by Fri EOD, legal + privacy by Mon noon, publish Wed AM. Everyone ack?

sam: Ack  will insert CSV link and method note.

jenni: Ack  will confirm dry run and attendee invites.

oliver: Ack  will paste webhook trace after test.

kasia: Ack  will complete claim checklist and chase Privacy.

alex: Thanks all  I'll lock the draft after legal greenlight. :thumbsup:
